# The wide frames (rd_sideband_ab, rd_region_camera_ab): a fixture, its frame's
# aspect (the replays' --aspect), then the line's own properties
# (rd_fixture_list_props.cmake): side_band_card_draws on the side bands' replay
# under the PS2's rule (0 at 4:3: the picture is the frame, the mode is off),
# region_rule_draws on the camera rule's.  The generated geometry drops no
# triangle the side bands or the camera rule would draw (--region-stats: drop
# 0 on every committed fixture), so both tests hold the pictures the same with
# those modes on (docs/port/TESTING_FIXTURES.md).
#
# the PowerVR phone's one 4:3 frame: the control
fx-wide-6818 4:3 side_band_card_draws=0 region_rule_draws>=1
# the PowerVR phone, GS 848x448 at 2.189
fx-phone-4657 2.189 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
# issue 189, GS 624x448 at 16:10 (stage 32's exit)
fx-wide-189 16:10 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
# the Mali-G52 reporter's frame (issue 179), GS 912x512 at its own 2.3704 (full
# height); a 16:9 fixture of a version 15+ dump does not exist: issue 102's
# gate (version 11) has no facing tables, so the side bands' mode holds none of
# its card draws (side_band_card_draws 0, measured)
fx-mali-frame 2.3704 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
# the main gate, GS 2048x448 at 48:9
fx-maingate 48:9 side_band_card_draws>=1 region_rule_draws>=1
